name: Bruno
waitingLines: Gotta give {partner} a big hug before I go. Big feelings. Big wait.
I brought {partner} some honey. I’ll wait to give it in person. I might cry.

questions.scene: Bruno ducks through your door in a tiny knitted hat, holding a jar of honey like a trophy.
lines: Hi hi! Clover made me this hat. I cried. Anyway, quiz! Big feelings. Big hugs.
questions.question: About how much does a newborn bear cub weigh?

choices.label: About as much as a watermelon
reply: Aww, that would be easier to hold! But no.
Newborn cubs weigh about a pound. Like a loaf of bread.
Such tiny beans. I'm already emotional.

choices.label: About one pound
reply: Yes!! One tiny pound!
Mama bear can be hundreds of times heavier than her newborn cub.
Clover's cubs will be that small. I'm going to hold them so gently. I'm crying.

choices.label: About as much as a grown wolf
reply: Whoa, no! That would be a huge baby!
Newborn cubs weigh about one pound.
They start tiny and blind. Then they grow, and grow, and grow.

questions.factBasis: Newborn bear cubs typically weigh around 0.5 kg (about a pound).

questions.scene: Bruno squeezes you in a gentle hug and holds on. Then sniffles.
lines: Big feelings. Big hugs. And science says hugs are good for you!
questions.question: Which hormone is released during warm touch and hugs?

choices.label: Adrenaline
reply: That's the scary one! Not hugs!
Hugs and touch can boost oxytocin.
It helps people feel close and calm. Big warm feelings.

choices.label: Oxytocin, often called the 'cuddle hormone'
reply: Yes!! The cuddle hormone!
Warm touch can raise oxytocin, linked to bonding and calm.
So hugging Clover is basically medicine. I'm prescribing more.

choices.label: Caffeine
reply: Ha! That's coffee, not hugs!
Oxytocin, the 'cuddle hormone,' rises with warm touch.
Hug more. Coffee less. Kidding. Both.

questions.factBasis: Warm partner contact is associated with higher oxytocin (Grewen et al. 2005).

questions.scene: Bruno balances an egg on his feet very carefully. It wobbles. He panics.
lines: This is practice. For a reason.
questions.question: How do emperor penguin dads care for their egg?

choices.label: They balance it on their feet for about two months
reply: Yes!! Dad goals!
They keep the egg warm on their feet under a fold of skin.
Through freezing winter, barely eating. I'm sobbing. Clover, I'm ready.

choices.label: They bury it in snow
reply: No!! It'd freeze!
Dads balance the egg on their feet under a warm skin flap.
For about two months, in the middle of winter.

choices.label: They hand it to a babysitter
reply: Aww, no! Dad duty!
Dads keep it on their feet, under a warm fold of skin.
Huddled together through blizzards. Hero dads.

questions.factBasis: Male emperor penguins incubate eggs on their feet for ~2 months.

questions.scene: Bruno hums happily while munching a cookie.
lines: When I eat, I hum. Clover says gorillas do this too!
questions.question: What do gorillas sometimes do while eating food they love?

choices.label: Throw it at friends
reply: Not the polite thing! No!
They hum and sing while eating.
Happy eating sounds. Same as me with honey.

choices.label: Eat in total silence
reply: The opposite! They're musical!
Gorillas hum and sing while eating favorite foods.
Snack symphony!

choices.label: Hum and sing
reply: Yes!! Snack songs!
Researchers recorded gorillas humming and 'singing' while eating.
Happy food sounds. I knew I wasn't weird.

questions.factBasis: Luef et al. (2016) documented gorillas humming/singing during feeding.

questions.scene: Bruno counts on his claws. Then counts again. Then gives up.
lines: How long do elephants wait for babies? I'll be impatient for days.
questions.question: How long is an elephant pregnancy?

choices.label: About 9 months
reply: That's humans! Elephants wait longer!
Elephant pregnancy lasts about 22 months.
Almost two years! I can't even wait for cookies to cool.

choices.label: About 3 weeks
reply: Way too short!
Elephants carry babies for about 22 months.
That's a long time to plan a nursery.

choices.label: About 22 months
reply: Yes! Almost two years!
It's the longest pregnancy of any land mammal.
Patience is a big feeling too.

questions.factBasis: African elephant gestation is about 22 months.

questions.scene: Bruno peeks at his own paw, curious.
lines: This one surprised me. Like, big surprise.
questions.question: What color is a polar bear's skin?

choices.label: White
reply: That's what I thought too!
Polar bear skin is actually black, under that white-looking fur.
Their fur is clear, not white. Mind blown.

choices.label: Black
reply: Yes!! Black skin!
Dark skin helps soak up the sun's warmth.
Their fur is actually see-through. It just looks white. Science is wild.

choices.label: Pink
reply: Aww, cute, but no!
Polar bear skin is black underneath.
Their fur looks white but is actually hollow and clear.

questions.factBasis: Polar bears have black skin; fur hairs are translucent.

questions.scene: Bruno holds up a photo of a koala, then his own paw, comparing.
lines: These are SO similar to human fingerprints. I'm in awe.
questions.question: What's surprising about koala fingerprints?

choices.label: They look almost identical to human fingerprints
reply: Yes!! Almost identical!
Even under a microscope, they're very hard to tell apart.
Imagine a koala solving a crime. Or committing one. Cute crime.

choices.label: Koalas don't have fingerprints
reply: They do! Very human-like!
Their prints look almost exactly like ours.
Nature is full of surprises.

choices.label: They glow pink
reply: That's the flying squirrel!
Koala fingerprints are nearly identical to humans'.
Hugging trees with human-like prints. Adorable.

questions.factBasis: Koala fingerprints closely resemble human fingerprints (Henneberg et al.).

questions.scene: Bruno holds up a jellybean between two claws, looking at it very tenderly.
lines: This tiny thing is a baby. Kind of. I'm emotional.
questions.question: How big is a newborn kangaroo joey?

choices.label: About the size of a puppy
reply: Close! Way smaller!
A newborn joey is about the size of a jellybean.
It climbs into the pouch all on its own.

choices.label: About the size of a jellybean
reply: Yes!! A jellybean!
A newborn joey crawls into mom's pouch and grows there for months.
Tiny and brave. I'm crying again. Big feelings.

choices.label: About the size of a basketball
reply: Whoa, no!
It's about the size of a jellybean.
It grows in the pouch for months. Nature is amazing.

questions.factBasis: Newborn kangaroo joeys are roughly jellybean-sized.

questions.scene: Bruno wipes a tear looking at a jellyfish video.
lines: This tiny jellyfish can start its life over. I'm emotional.
questions.question: What can the 'immortal jellyfish' do?

choices.label: Turn back into a younger stage when stressed
reply: Yes!! It can reverse its age!
When injured or stressed, it can revert to its baby polyp stage.
Starting over. Big feelings.

choices.label: Live in the desert
reply: Too dry! No!
It can revert back to a young polyp stage.
A natural do-over button.

choices.label: Glow brighter as it ages
reply: Pretty! Not it!
It can turn back into a younger form.
Life, round two. So hopeful.

questions.factBasis: Turritopsis dohrnii can revert to the polyp stage (transdifferentiation).

questions.scene: Bruno sniffs a pineapple and sighs patiently.
lines: Pineapples take forever to grow. Like waiting for cubs. Okay, not that long.
questions.question: About how long does it take for a pineapple to grow?

choices.label: About 2 weeks
reply: Way longer!
Pineapples take about 18 months to 2 years.
One fruit per plant at a time. Precious.

choices.label: They grow on trees in one day
reply: Ha! No! Not trees, and not fast!
They grow on short plants, taking about 18 months to 2 years.
Worth the wait.

choices.label: About 18 months to 2 years
reply: Yes!! A really long time!
Each plant usually produces just one pineapple at a time.
Patience is love. Clover says I need more.

questions.factBasis: A pineapple typically takes ~18–24 months to mature.

questions.scene: Bruno opens his arms wide, then waits kindly for an answer.
lines: Big feelings. Big hugs. But which first?
questions.question: When feelings get big: hug it out, or talk it out?

choices.label: Hug it out
reply: Hug it out!! Big hugs for big feelings!
No words needed. Just warmth.

choices.label: Talk it out
reply: Talk it out. Brave and honest.
Words can make big feelings smaller.

A:A: You both hug it out!! Big bear hug energy!
{partner} wraps you up, you wrap them up. No talking needed.
I'm tearing up. That's beautiful.
A:B: Talk it out for you. {partner} wants to hug it out.
They'll come in for a squeeze. You'll want words.
Talk while hugging. Totally allowed. Very effective.
B:A: Hug it out for you. {partner} wants to talk it out.
You'll open your arms. They'll open their mouth. Both are love.
Hug first, then talk. Best combo. Trust a bear.
B:B: You both talk it out! Big feelings, big words.
So you and {partner} untangle things together. Out loud. Bravely.
Then hug anyway. Just for the bonus points.

questions.scene: Bruno shows you a closet stuffed with tiny socks, hats, and blankets. For cubs not born yet.
lines: I may have overprepared. A little. A lot.
questions.question: Getting ready for something big: prepare everything early, or figure it out as you go?

choices.label: Prepare early
reply: Prepare early! Like me! Twelve tiny hats!
Being ready feels safe.

choices.label: Figure it out as we go
reply: Figure it out as you go. Brave!
Flexible hearts handle surprises.

A:A: Prepare-early couple! Matching checklists!
Honestly, {partner} and you probably packed for a trip three weeks ahead.
Clover would love you. I already do.
A:B: You go with the flow. {partner} prepares early.
They'll have a list. You'll have vibes.
Let them prepare. You make it fun. Team bear.
B:A: You prepare early. {partner} figures it out as they go.
You'll pack the bag. They'll pack the snacks. Last minute.
Balance! You're the plan. They're the fun.
B:B: Figure-it-out couple! Chill bears!
I can picture it: you and {partner} trust you'll handle whatever comes.
Teach me. I have 47 tiny socks and no chill.

questions.scene: Bruno drizzles honey onto a spoon and hums contentedly.
lines: Honey question. The most important question.
questions.question: Honey goes best on: toast, pancakes, or straight from the spoon?

choices.label: Toast
reply: Toast! Crunchy sweet perfection.
Butter, then honey. Classic.

choices.label: Pancakes
reply: Pancakes! Fluffy golden dreams.
A honey waterfall.

choices.label: Straight from the spoon
reply: Straight from the spoon! A true bear!
No middleman. Pure love.

A:A: Toast for both of you! Breakfast twins!
Pretty sure {partner} and you fight over the crust. Cute fight.
Honey toast for two. Breakfast in bed. Go.
A:B: Pancakes for you! {partner} picks toast.
Pancake toast? Is that a thing? Make it a thing.
Honey brunch for two. Perfect.
A:C: Straight from the spoon! {partner} prefers toast.
They're civilized. You're a bear. Respect.
Hand them toast. Keep the spoon.
B:A: Toast for you! {partner} picks pancakes.
Crunchy versus fluffy. The great breakfast debate.
Make both and drizzle honey on everything. Even the plates. Okay, not the plates.
B:B: Pancakes for both of you! Fluffy couple!
Lowkey, you and {partner} make a pancake tower on Sundays, don't you?
Stack them high. Pour honey everywhere.
B:C: They're making breakfast. You're eating the honey.
Save some for the pancakes. Some.
C:A: Toast for you! {partner} eats it from the spoon.
They'll lick the spoon while you butter the toast.
Share the jar. Love is sticky.
C:B: Pancakes for you! {partner} goes straight to the spoon.
You pour it on pancakes. They pour it in their mouth.
Both valid. Both sticky. Both love.
C:C: Straight from the spoon! Both of you! Bear souls!
{partner} and you sneak spoonfuls at midnight. I know it.
Two spoons, one jar. True love.

questions.scene: Bruno pulls out two pictures: a fluffy puppy and a sleepy cat.
lines: Clover and I talk about pets. A lot. Big decision.
questions.question: Someday pet: a dog, or a cat?

choices.label: A dog
reply: A dog! Walks, wags, and zoomies!
A best friend that greets you like it's been ten years.

choices.label: A cat
reply: A cat! Independent, cozy, majestic.
They love you on their own terms.

A:A: Dog for both of you! Zoomies forever!
So {partner} and you will walk a happy pup every morning.
Name it something silly. Like Biscuit. Sorry, Biscuit.
A:B: Cat for you. {partner} wants a dog.
They want zoomies. You want purrs.
Both! A cat and dog cuddle pile. I'm crying.
B:A: Dog for you. {partner} wants a cat.
One barks, one judges. The classic household.
Get both. Raise them together. They'll be best friends. Maybe.
B:B: Cat for both of you! Purr-fect couple!
Honestly, you and {partner} will lose arguments to a cat. Every day.
Get a sunny window. Cats need sunny windows.

questions.scene: Bruno sniffles into a tissue during a commercial about puppies.
lines: I cry at everything now. Is that normal?
questions.question: Crying at movies: proudly, or secretly?

choices.label: Proudly
reply: Proudly! Like me! Tears are big feelings!
Let them flow. No shame.

choices.label: Secretly
reply: Secretly. Sneaky tear wipe.
'Something in my eye.' Classic.

A:A: Proud criers, both of you! Tissue box couple!
I can picture it: {partner} and you sob together at every sad dog movie.
That's beautiful. Truly. I'm crying about it.
A:B: You cry secretly. {partner} cries proudly.
They're openly sobbing. You're coughing suspiciously.
Join them. It feels so good. Big feelings, big tears.
B:A: You cry proudly. {partner} cries secretly.
You'll be sobbing. They'll be 'fixing their eyelash.'
Hand them a tissue. Don't say anything. Love.
B:B: Secret criers, both of you!
Pretty sure you and {partner} both pretend there's dust in the air.
Next time, cry together. Honestly. It's nice.

questions.scene: Bruno gives you a questioning look, arms half open.
lines: How do you like your hugs? This matters to me deeply.
questions.question: How does your partner like to be hugged?
questions.selfQuestion: How do you like to be hugged?

choices.label: Tight bear hug
reply: Tight bear hug! My specialty!
Squeeze that love in.

choices.label: Gentle and soft
reply: Gentle and soft. So tender.
Like holding a cloud.

choices.label: Long and swaying
reply: Long and swaying. Slow dance hug!
Rock back and forth. Forever.

A:A: Tight bear hug, and {partner} knew it!
They squeeze you like they mean it.
Professional hugger recognizes professional hugger.
A:B: Gentle for you. {partner} guessed bear hug.
They're squeezing too hard. Lovingly too hard.
Tell them: soft like a cloud. They'll adjust.
A:C: Long and swaying for you. {partner} guessed bear hug.
They squeeze and let go. You want to rock forever.
Hold on longer. They'll get the hint.
B:A: Bear hug for you. {partner} guessed gentle.
They're holding back. You want the full squeeze.
Tell them: 'Squeeze harder.' Best instruction ever.
B:B: Gentle and soft, and {partner} knew it!
They hold you like something precious. Because you are.
I'm tearing up. Of course I am.
B:C: Long and swaying for you. {partner} guessed gentle.
They're soft but quick. You want slow.
Sway them next time. They'll love it.
C:A: Bear hug for you. {partner} guessed long and swaying.
Squeeze AND sway. The ultimate hug.
C:B: Gentle for you. {partner} guessed long and swaying.
Close! Soft and slow. Almost perfect.
Gentle sway. That's a dreamy hug.
C:C: Long and swaying, and {partner} knew it!
They sway with you like a slow dance in the kitchen.

questions.scene: Bruno sits beside you with a soft rumble, offering a cookie.
lines: Sad days happen. What helps?
questions.question: When your partner is sad, what helps most?
questions.selfQuestion: When you're sad, what helps most?

choices.label: A hug, no words
reply: A hug, no words. Just being there.
Sometimes that's everything.

choices.label: Their favorite snack
reply: Favorite snack. Comfort food heals.
Cookies fix hearts. Science. Probably.

A:A: A wordless hug, and {partner} knew it!
They just hold you. No questions. No fixes.
That's the most loving thing. I'm crying.
A:B: A snack helps you. {partner} guessed a hug.
They're opening their arms. You're opening the pantry.
Hug them while eating. Efficient comfort.
B:A: A hug helps you. {partner} guessed snacks.
They're bringing cookies. You need arms.
Take the cookie. Then ask for the hug. Both work.
B:B: Favorite snack, and {partner} knew it!
They show up with your comfort food before you even ask.
Snack love is real love.

questions.scene: Bruno opens a drawer full of tiny jars, buttons, and spoons.
lines: My collection. Clover calls it 'the bear hoard.'
questions.question: What does your partner secretly hoard?

choices.label: Cute mugs
reply: Cute mugs! A cabinet full!
One for every mood.

choices.label: Snacks in hidden places
reply: Hidden snacks! A secret stash!
In coat pockets. In drawers. Everywhere.

A:A: Cute mugs, and {partner} knew it!
They've seen the overflowing cabinet.
Buy them one more. They'll pretend they don't need it.
A:B: You hoard snacks. {partner} guessed mugs.
They don't know about the secret chocolate drawer.
Tell them. Or don't. Snack secrets are sacred.
B:A: You hoard mugs. {partner} guessed snacks.
They're looking for food. Your cabinet is just mugs.
Hide snacks in the mugs. Two hoards, one shelf.
B:B: Hidden snacks, and {partner} knew it!
They've found the chips behind the cereal.
Share the stash. Or find a better hiding spot.

questions.scene: Bruno practices rocking a tiny teddy bear, very carefully.
lines: I keep imagining what kind of parent I'll be. You two?
questions.question: As a parent (or pet parent), what would your partner be like?
questions.selfQuestion: As a parent (or pet parent), what would you be like?

choices.label: The fun one
reply: The fun one! Pillow forts! Ice cream for dinner!
Every day is an adventure.

choices.label: The worrier who packs everything
reply: The worrier! Snacks, band-aids, sunscreen!
Ready for anything. Like me.

A:A: The fun one, and {partner} knew it!
They know you'll be building blanket forts every weekend.
Bring me. I'll bring honey.
A:B: You'd be the worrier. {partner} guessed the fun one.
They imagine you jumping in puddles. You'd be holding umbrellas.
That's okay. Worry is love too. I know.
B:A: You'd be the fun one. {partner} guessed the worrier.
They think you'd pack everything. You'd pack only fun.
They'll handle the band-aids. You handle the giggles.
B:B: The worrier, and {partner} knew it!
They know you'll pack three backup snacks for a ten-minute walk.
Same. Clover laughs at me. Lovingly.

questions.scene: Bruno wipes a happy tear just thinking about good news.
lines: Big news reactions! Mine involves lots of tears.
questions.question: When your partner gets big news, how do they react?
questions.selfQuestion: When you get big news, how do you react?

choices.label: Happy-cries immediately
reply: Happy-cries! Like me!
Tears of joy. The best kind.

choices.label: Goes quiet, then screams
reply: Quiet, then scream! Dramatic!
The delay is the best part.

A:A: Happy tears, and {partner} knew it!
They had the tissues ready before you even opened the letter.
Crying buddies forever.
A:B: You go quiet then scream. {partner} expected tears.
They have tissues. You have volume.
Scream into their shoulder. Then they can cry.
B:A: You happy-cry. {partner} expected quiet then screaming.
They're bracing for a scream. You're sobbing happily.
Both are big feelings. Both are beautiful.
B:B: Quiet then scream, and {partner} knew it!
They watch your face freeze, then cover their ears.
Love the drama. Honestly.
